title: Stupid Login
description: Adds a password system for offline servers, as well as admin commands to manage them.
body:
![Mod logo. It says "Stupid Login"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de57fb6627a9af6d0eb5c3e10d01010af1c4c45d.png)

![Page separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ef1ee6bcff8c50b9200d780a659eaf573aec8b9_0.webp)

![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce35cddac6f6c8e4b513a9847a2d0f2aff24d01.png)

When playing on offline servers, you may encounter account theft through simply changing a nickname. This mod solves that problem.

This mod adds a password system for offline servers and commands to manage them.

![Page separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ef1ee6bcff8c50b9200d780a659eaf573aec8b9_0.webp)

![How it works?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/218b42c904cba9bd7b9ec6fcf482f2c6f687c66a.png)

Using a special command, you can set a password for your account.

Upon joining the server, a menu will appear where you need to enter the password to start playing.


<details>
<summary>Screenshot</summary>

![A screenshot from the game showing the password interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe273d2b9d680ad5ba1aa8b762d91bbb13f23c7f_0.webp)

</details>



You can also add a hint for your password to help you remember it if you forget.

<details>
<summary>Screenshot</summary>


![Ability to add password hints](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7eec4b738ef2430724c7997832330004d90e6192.png)

</details>


**While entering your password, you are immortal.**


![Page separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ef1ee6bcff8c50b9200d780a659eaf573aec8b9_0.webp)

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6062cd9fd181583b86a2e2bf3ebb70124d57717.png)

- Ability to set a password

- Change password

- Password hints

- Admin commands

- Built-in Russian translation

<details>
<summary>Screenshot</summary>

![Build-in russian translation resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cee19faec9af7b60b634c243251e3f6a09e2e8a4.png)

</details>


![Page separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ef1ee6bcff8c50b9200d780a659eaf573aec8b9_0.webp)

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d0ea9f0f159ea5d19c58e33e97dec35e8795534.png)
### For regular users:
```/password set YourPassword```

- Sets a password

```/password reset```

- Opens the password change menu

```/password hint set YourHintText```

- Sets a hint to help you remember your password

```/password hint remove```

- Removes the hint

### For administration:

```/stupidlogin info```

- Shows information about the mod

```/stupidlogin get PlayerTarget```

- Shows the target player's password

```/stupidlogin set PlayerTarget Password```

- Force-sets a password for a player

```/stupidlogin remove PlayerTarget```

- Removes a player's password

![Page separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ef1ee6bcff8c50b9200d780a659eaf573aec8b9_0.webp)
